limitations: PARTIAL SCOPE: the 36 mouse runs are excluded (28 YLJI_310717_040817_FISH_GP9_TiO2_Phos_frac{5-17,54}{a,b}.raw = mouse GPome, fc180214_gpome_mouse.csv; 8 J_Corso_291116_LMP2A_{6,7}_pY_{1,2}.raw and J_Corso_161317_pY_MYC_{8,9}_1_{1,2}.raw = mouse pYome, fc171021_pyome_mouse.csv). The paper describes the mouse conditions (MYC unstimulated, MYC 5-min BCR-stimulated, MYC/LMP2A unstimulated; tumour cell lines from lambda-MYC and LMP2A/lambda-MYC mice) but states no SILAC channel for any of them (Fig. S2 is in the SI appendix, which is behind a PMC proof-of-work check and PNAS 403, not bypassed), and the 8 pYome runs vs 4 csv replicates are not mapped. Listed in BLOCKED.md.

Stimulation time conflict: Methods "Global Proteome Analysis" and "Phosphopeptide Enrichment for pYome Analysis" (and the PRIDE protocol) say "after 3 h of BCR stimulation", whereas Methods "Cell Culture and BCR Stimulation" says "5 min (for all proteome analyses) or 3 h (for RNA-seq)" and Fig. 1A/1D show 5'. 5 min is encoded; deposited proteome H/L shows only 22 of 4392 proteins with |log2| >= 1 and no immediate-early protein induction, consistent with 5 min.

pYome-A vs pYome-B file-set assignment rests on acquisition dates (raw header directories and file names) relative to the csv file-name dates; no source states it directly. The deposited ratio patterns (Spearman 0.20 vs 0.90) fit Fig. 1C vs 1D.

pYome samples 195/198/201 and 773/776/779 are treated as biologically independent mixes (replicates); the paper only says "at least four replicates" were required for the LCL pYome and does not say whether the three IPs per set came from independent cultures.

Biological-replicate numbering continues across sub-experiments (proteome, GPome, pYome-A, pYome-B) because each was prepared on a different date; whether any lysate was shared between sub-experiments is not stated.

Donor information (age, sex, ancestry, individual) of the LCLs is not given in the paper (refers to ref. 7; only "healthy human peripheral blood B cells") -> not available. Organism part = blood from that sentence.

Donor confounding: the EBV-WT and LMP2A-KO LCLs almost certainly come from different donors. Proteome (fc170923_proteome_lcl.csv, median over r1-r5) HLA allele groups have M/L (EBV-WT/LMP2A-KO) of 0.02-0.04 (HLA-DRB1 0.020, HLA-A 0.035/0.040, HLA-B 0.038, HLA-DRB3 0.031) or 26-53x (HLA-DRB1/DRB5 26, HLA-C 36, HLA-DRB1-1113 49, HLA-B 53), while H/L (two KO cultures) stays ~0.8-1.9. Genotype (LMP2A WT vs KO) is therefore confounded with donor; characteristics[individual] is not available because no donor IDs are published, so the SDRF cannot encode the two donors.

Proteome replicates: all five proteome replicates share one sample id and preparation date in the file names (TO_K_Fish_220517_*_GPome_192_L2_rep1-5), whereas the paper calls them "five biological replicates"; they are numbered 1-5 per the paper, but whether they are independent cultures or replicate preparations of one mix cannot be checked from the deposit.
Supplementary Datasets S1-S7 and SI Appendix (Fig. S1A, S2) not retrievable (PMC bin URLs return a proof-of-work bot check, pnas.org 403, Europe PMC render 403).
pYome reduction/alkylation reagents not stated (CST PTMScan kit per manufacturer) -> not available.
